baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence concedes that a warning actually arrived and then links receipt to active rejection with فـ; the failure is not lack of access but attributing falsehood to an alarm after it reached them.

activation_trace.role: Actual coming and obtaining establish successful arrival as the first step of the mechanism.
A warning that awakens caution identifies what the arriving figure was functionally meant to do.
Attributing a person or message to falsehood makes their response an active verdict against the received warning.

changed_reading.before: They did not accept a warning.
changed_reading.after: Their own account first certifies successful warning-delivery and only then records their deliberate counter-verdict against it.

baseline_models.mechanism: Negation with مِن شَىْءٍ gives the claim total scope: they move beyond disputing this warning to denying any divinely delivered, knowable object whatsoever.

activation_trace.role: Causing something to descend and reach a recipient supplies the denied delivery relation.
A thing that can be known and reported lets the negative construction range over every possible delivered object.

changed_reading.before: They denied that God sent this message.
changed_reading.after: They answer one arrived warning with an unrestricted theory that no divine delivery of any kind has occurred.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍ كَبِيرٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: The exclusive construction confines the warners inside deviation, while كَبِير magnifies the diagnosis; rejection is defended by relocating error wholly onto the messengers.

activation_trace.role: Deviation from guidance and intended course supplies the condition into which the warners are rhetorically confined.
Magnitude opposed to smallness scales the alleged deviation into a comprehensive charge.

changed_reading.before: They called the warners badly misguided.
changed_reading.after: Their defense works by total diagnostic displacement: all deviation is assigned to the warning side and enlarged there.

baseline_models.mechanism: An outer present report contains their remembered earlier speech. The same speakers now reproduce the proposition by which they formerly rejected the warning, creating a two-time contrast within one utterance.

activation_trace.role: Voiced utterance joins the present answer and the quoted past response in one audible report.
Speech as belief or position makes the inner quotation disclose the stance that governed their earlier rejection.

changed_reading.before: They recount what they once said.
changed_reading.after: Their present voice contains and exposes their former creed, making the ayah a compact reconstruction of changed temporal perspective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The guardians' question elicits the outer answer; the answer embeds the speakers' own earlier words; subsequent recognition names the outcome as their offense, while hidden and public speech remain equally exposed. The nested two-time report therefore functions as self-produced evidence, not neutral reminiscence.

activation_trace.role: The two voiced sayings supply both the elicited testimony and the incriminating historical quotation inside it.
Questioning and requesting supply the prompt that immediately calls forth the focus answer.
Confession as acknowledgment or submission confirms that the surrounding speech sequence culminates in self-recognition.
Concealment in the interior extends the evidentiary field even to speech kept hidden.
Public declaration and raised voice complete the hidden-to-open span across which speech is exposed.

structural_cues: The question in 67:8 immediately precedes and governs the answer in 67:9.
The outer قَالُوا encloses the earlier وَقُلْنَا, so the speakers quote their own rejecting words.
67:10 continues the first-person admission and 67:11 converts it into explicit confession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies question, nested self-quotation, confession, and the hidden/public speech pair; I supply the forensic arrow that treats the quotation as evidence against its speakers. A live alternative is moral self-recognition without a formal testimonial frame.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a past disagreement in dialogue.
changed_reading.after: The speakers answer an examination by furnishing the very past utterance that establishes their knowing rejection.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hearing-as-responsive understanding and reason-as-restraint identify the capacities they admit not using; the later upright path comparison spatializes the lost course; finally the same فِى ضَلَالٍ frame returns with disclosure rather than mere magnitude. Their accusation becomes a mislocated diagnosis that the sequence returns to its speakers.

activation_trace.role: Deviation from guidance supplies the charge initially assigned to the warners and later reassigned by the context.
Hearing as understanding and compliance turns their admitted failure into failed reception rather than absent sound.
Reason that restrains ignorance supplies the missing check on their displaced verdict.
Gentle direction toward path and truth gives ضلال its opposed directional axis.
The straight path materializes the intended course from which the focus charge alleges deviation.
Repetition of deviation in the same prepositional frame reopens the focus accusation with the subject now under judgment.
Appearance and disclosure change the issue from asserted greatness to an identity that will become exposed.

structural_cues: 67:9 says إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَالٍ كَبِيرٍ, while 67:29 asks who is فِى ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ.
67:10 locates failure in unused hearing and reasoning immediately after the focus answer.
67:22 contrasts face-down movement with upright movement on a straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the mirrored error construction, failed faculties, and path contrast; I supply the reflexive arrow by which the accusation rebounds onto its speakers. The clauses could be independent diagnoses, but their lexical and structural recurrence keeps reversal strongly live.

changed_reading.before: The rejecters simply accuse the warners of major error.
changed_reading.after: The accusation anticipates its own reversal: those who refused understanding and path-orientation will be disclosed inside the deviation they projected outward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later demand asks for the promise's time, but the reply separates knowledge held by God from the messenger's clear warning-role. Read back into the focus, 'God sent nothing' can be a category collapse: because exhaustive schedule-knowledge was not delivered, they treated the delivered warning as nothing.

activation_trace.role: The alarm that awakens caution defines a sufficient practical function short of disclosing every detail.
Delivered descent anchors the issue in whether communication reached them, not whether it exhausted divine knowledge.
A promise bounded by time or place supplies the timetable the challengers demand.
Knowledge as disclosure to a knower marks the information retained with God in the reply.
The repeated warning-role preserves cautionary communication despite the limit on timetable knowledge.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign makes the warning clear without making it exhaustive.

structural_cues: 67:25 asks مَتَىٰ about the promised event.
67:26 answers with a division between divine knowledge and a clear warning-role.
67:9 itself first admits that a warner came and then denies that anything was sent down.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a temporal challenge, restricted knowledge, and a repeated clear warning-role; I infer that demanded completeness can motivate treating limited but adequate warning as zero communication. Their focus denial may instead be a blanket doctrinal claim unrelated to timing.

changed_reading.before: They deny the content or source of the warning.
changed_reading.after: They may be converting an epistemic limit into total negation, refusing to count a clear alarm because it does not deliver the schedule they demand.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening 'every thing' and the focus 'no thing' form opposed totals. Later, apportioned provision can be withheld, and water can descend beyond reach or be brought. These controlled arrivals broaden the denied descent-relation: their claim resists being recipients dependent on what reaches them, while the context repeatedly stages giving, holding, sinking, and coming.

activation_trace.role: Caused descent and delivery anchor the focus claim in a vertical relation between giver, conveyed thing, and recipient.
The reportable thing under negation gives their denial unrestricted object scope.
The same known or reportable thing under كُلِّ supplies the opening universal that opposes the focus's مِن شَىْءٍ.
Capacity that reaches effective action places the universal field under operative control.
Apportioned giving supplies a concrete class of benefits received rather than self-originated.
Holding and restraining make the continuation of provision contingent rather than automatic.
Conveying water by pouring or watering makes delivery materially inspectable at the surah's close.
Descent into depth reverses accessible arrival by placing the needed substance beyond reach.
Coming and arrival frame restored water as something that must reach the recipients.

structural_cues: 67:1 places كُلِّ شَىْءٍ under capacity; 67:9 negates descent مِن شَىْءٍ.
67:21 makes provision conditional by imagining it withheld.
67:30 closes with water sunk downward and the question of who can bring accessible water.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed thing-quantifiers and concrete controls on provision and water; I infer a common giver-to-recipient dependency relation and read it back into نَزَّلَ. The materially broader reading should remain secondary to the direct possibility that descent here denotes communication alone.

changed_reading.after: Their unrestricted denial also resists the recipient-position itself, despite a context organized around controlled things continually reaching, sustaining, or eluding them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping and must not replace the lexical sense of saying. It remains anchored in both focus speech forms and is activated by the immediately surrounding inhaling roar and boiling; downstream prose should present it only as an acoustic-affective resonance in how the confession may be heard.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَالُوا ... وَقُلْنَا through the packet's split mapping to ق ل ل

activation_trace.role: Trembling and agitation give the two speech moments an exploratory bodily instability without displacing their ordinary verbal meaning.
Drawn or returning breath supplies the audible pressure surrounding the speakers' present answer.
Boiling and surging turn the setting into a physically unstable acoustic chamber for the confession.

changed_reading.before: The outer and inner sayings are two stable quoted propositions.
changed_reading.after: As a contained sound-image, the present admission can tremble around the remembered certainty of the earlier denial, making changed perspective audible in the voice itself.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the guest-provision branch of ن ز ل is not the direct lexical rendering of نَزَّلَ. It remains anchored in the focus root, the warning's arrival, and later provision and water-delivery cues; downstream prose should qualify it as a social-material analogy for refused dependence, never as a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جَاءَنَا نَذِيرٌ ... مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ

activation_trace.role: An actual arrival supplies one side of the guest-and-reception analogy.
Provision prepared for an arriving guest supplies the exploratory social image attached to the denied descent.
Apportioned giving extends the host-like provision image into material dependence.
Water conveyed by pouring or watering gives the analogy a concrete sustaining gift.
Giving supplies the donor-to-recipient direction inferred for the final water question.

changed_reading.before: They deny that a message descended from God.
changed_reading.after: As a contained hospitality analogy, they refuse both the arriving warning and the status of guests sustained by what a host makes reach them.

strongest_changes: The focus's charge of great error becomes a reversible diagnosis, returning as manifest error after failed hearing, reasoning, and path-orientation.
The outer answer and inner historical quotation become self-indicting testimony elicited by a question and completed by confession.
The distinction between unavailable timetable knowledge and a clear warning reframes total denial as a possible demand that limited communication count as none.
The all-thing/no-thing opposition and controlled provision-water sequence widen descent into a recipient-dependency relation.
summary.what_was_special: The ayah contains an unusually compressed receipt-to-denial-to-countercharge chain and lets the same speakers voice both present admission and former certainty; later context activates an exact reversal of their diagnostic phrase and several concrete models of what reaches a recipient.
remaining_uncertainties: The 67:29 error phrase may be thematic recurrence rather than a deliberately direct rebound of 67:9.
The provision and water model should remain secondary if نَزَّلَ is kept narrowly communicative.
The ق و ل to ق ل ل outlier is only a split-root acoustic activation, not a lexical gloss.
